name: concept_slimedragon
refs: pixel art style, glossy goo shading, body size and the goo puddle lower body to match (not the head or colors)
desc: A slender muscular slime dragon monster made of glossy light sky-blue goo with darker blue rounded blotch spots, three-quarter view facing left, standing idle, pixel art sprite. Dragon head with long snout and pointed fin-like ears dripping goo, pale blue eyes, sly smile with the tongue slightly out, lean defined muscles, one hand raised near the chin, lower body melting into a light blue goo puddle on the floor, drips running down. Clean dark outline, glossy highlights, same pixel art style as the reference.
